blurb: Marvin 6.3.0 is an open-source C UCI and XBoard chess engine by Martin Danielsson, rewritten and open-sourced in 2017 after an earlier closed-source line from 2002 to 2005. It embeds an incrementally updated 768 -> 1024x2 -> 1 NNUE network backed by an evaluation cache and pairs it with plain magic bitboards, ProbCut, singular extensions, razoring, and countermove/follow-up history pruning. Adapted to UCI over WASI on the poll helper using WebAssembly exception handling for search abort via setjmp/longjmp.
fidelityNotes: Single-threaded plain wasm32-wasip1 build requiring WebAssembly exception handling (requires=exception-handling for setjmp/longjmp); NNUE weights embedded via C23 #embed; no Syzygy tablebases or opening book.

features.label: Plain Magic Bitboards
features.implementation: Plain 64-bit magic bitboards alongside an 8x8 piece mailbox.

features.label: PVS
features.implementation: Iterative deepening PVS with narrow initial aspiration windows and quiescence search.

features.label: Null Move Pruning
features.implementation: Dynamic null-move pruning from depth 3 scaled by depth.

features.label: Late Move Reductions
features.implementation: Precomputed depth/move-number reduction table alongside late move pruning up to depth 10.

features.label: Futility & Reverse Futility
features.implementation: Depth-indexed futility and reverse futility pruning margins up to depth 7.

features.label: Razoring
features.implementation: Quiescence verification pruning for weak positions up to depth 3.

features.label: ProbCut
features.implementation: Reduced capture search from depth 5 pruning clear beta cutoffs.

features.label: Singular Extensions
features.implementation: Exclusion search from depth 8 extending singular transposition-table moves.

features.label: Countermove & Follow-up History
features.implementation: History, killer, and countermove ordering plus countermove and follow-up history pruning up to depth 3.

features.label: Bucketed Transposition Table
features.implementation: Three-entry transposition table buckets storing bounds, PV flags, depth, and best moves.

features.label: Embedded NNUE & Cache
features.implementation: Incrementally updated 768 -> 1024x2 -> 1 quantized NNUE paired with a 2 MB evaluation hash cache.
